title: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) – ISACA
overview: The Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) course is designed to provide comprehensive knowledge and skills required for auditing, controlling, and assessing information systems. This course prepares participants for the CISA certification exam by covering key domains related to information systems auditing, control, and governance.
audience: System and network administrators involved in auditing and compliance.
IT managers and consultants interested in information systems auditing.
Individuals preparing for the CISA certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of CISA concepts and domains.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for auditing and assessing information systems.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply CISA concepts and solutions.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore auditing challenges and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to measure understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of information systems auditing principles and practices.
To prepare participants for the CISA certification exam.
To equip learners with practical skills for auditing and assessing information systems.
To familiarize participants with best practices and advanced concepts in information systems auditing and control.

outline.title: 1. The Process of Auditing Information Systems

items.text: Understanding the Role and Responsibilities of an IS Auditor
Planning and Conducting Audits of Information Systems
Designing and Implementing Audit Programs
Collecting, Analyzing, and Reporting Audit Evidence
Understanding IT Governance Frameworks and Best Practices
Evaluating IT Management and Organizational Structures
Assessing IT Policies, Procedures, and Compliance
Understanding the Role of IT Governance in Risk Management

outline.title: 3. Information Systems Acquisition, Development, and Implementation

items.text: Evaluating IT Project Management and Development Practices
Assessing System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Processes
Understanding the Role of Auditing in System Implementation
Reviewing Controls for Software Development and Acquisition

outline.title: 4. Information Systems Operations, Maintenance, and Support

items.text: Evaluating IT Operations and Service Management
Assessing System Maintenance and Support Practices
Understanding the Role of Auditing in IT Operations
Reviewing IT Support and Incident Management Processes
Understanding Information Security and Risk Management
Evaluating Controls for Information Security and Data Protection
Assessing Network and System Security Measures
Reviewing Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
